an AI assistant helping a US-based content creator, I have broken down the best tools, industry options, and a streamlined workflow to help you turn long-form podcast episodes into viral shorts (TikToks, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts). 

Here is a comprehensive guide based on current industry standards and creator workflows.

---

### Part 1: Key Industry Options & Software Tools

The podcast-to-shorts landscape is divided into **AI-powered repurposing engines** (which do the heavy lifting automatically) and **manual/hybrid editors** (for precise control and stylized captions).

#### 1. AI-Driven Repurposing Tools (Best for Speed & Volume)
*   **Opus Clip:** One of the market leaders for AI clipping. It uses a "curation score" to rank the most viral-worthy hooks from your long-form video, auto-crops the speaker, adds dynamic captions, and packages them into ready-to-post shorts.
